page.notes: The second paragraph's marginal note reads "Isa. 1. 2" with a doubtful final digit; the printed reference is partly cut at the margin. The Isaiah quotation "Heu consolationem capiam" is Isa. 1:24 in the Vulgate, but the printed number is copied as seen. The line below the last full line contains faint, partly illegible text at the left edge, which may be show-through; it is not transcribed. The printed "H iiij" is read as a gathering signature and "&" as the catchword. The printed form "feueriffime" with a long s is read as "seueriffimè". Several words are printed in italic, and italic runs are marked as seen, but the exact extent of italic in paragraph two is approximate.
